result:
I've finished round 331 (stage c2a). All of my acceptance rows pass. C still has to run the browser and performance checks. Nothing is committed or pushed.

**What changed:** I applied B's patch exactly as written (`git apply`, no retyping). Then I edited doc 232 by hand. Exactly 5 files are modified and nothing is untracked:
- `preview-store.ts` gets the field roles record and the two "same shown fields" comparisons.
- `StudioWorkspace.tsx` gets the `useEqualityStableSelector` hook and the new readout and detail-panel selectors. The `useShallow` import is gone.
- Two test files carry DP25–DP28, PS-ROLES and PS-LIST.
- Doc 232 has the new status line, both gate-330 Lows fixed, a c2a section, the alternatives, problem/solution, testing and TODO entries. The 7 headings are still in order.

`ArrangementDetailPanel.tsx` and every protected file are unchanged.

**Results I actually ran:**
- **Claims:** before editing, the output matched B's planning output exactly. After, it differs from the sketch output only on the allowed lines (K2, K11, K12 `1 1 1 1`, K13 `11`).
- **Scope:** `git apply -R --check` passes and `ArrangementDetailPanel.tsx` has no diff (`a-round-331/scope.txt`).
- **Types and lint:** typecheck passes. `npm run lint` passes; it prints 205 warnings across the repo, but the Studio count (K15) stays at 16. Biome is clean on the 4 code files.
- **Unit tests:** all 17 covering files pass, 247/247. No test takes more than half its timeout.
- **Mutants:** all 7 fail on the expected tests, run on a scratch copy outside `store/`. The files were restored afterwards.
- **Data safety:** the detail panel can keep an old clip object whose fade values are out of date. I checked every detail-panel action: each uses only the displayed fields and none writes the whole clip back. So no old fade or envelope value can be saved.

**Code review:** the code-reviewer ran on the 5 files. It only read the code; it had no shell and ran no tests. Score 8/10, nothing Critical or High.
- I fixed three Low doc-accuracy points in doc 232.
- **A-R331-REVIEW-STALE-CLIP (Medium, latent).** The detail panel's selection still carries the full clip type with possibly stale fade values. No current code reads them, and nothing fails today. The fix belongs to the existing signal SIG-R331-DETAIL-PICK, outside my files. B needs to decide whether it blocks the stage, given the rule for Mediums that can't be reproduced.
- **Two Low test-gap proposals for B:**
  - The fake test audio is all zeros, so the markup tests can't see a waveform that depends on fades.
  - DP27 only covers a single selected clip.
- **Architecture note for B:** keep the hook local for now. When c2b lands, consider adding an optional `isEqual` to `useArrangementPreview` and moving the lane hook onto the same path.

**Not done by me:** C still runs all browser and performance rows: DRAG-NAMES, PERF, FADE/TRIM/MOVE/GROUP-SHOWN, D-ROWS and G331-AUTH. The full test suite, build and verify are left to the root gate. One TODO bullet in doc 232 still uses the old "c2 remaining" wording; I left it as a known gap.

The full report is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-331.md`, with logs in `a-round-331/`.
